title: The Lost Increment
description:
## Fix the Bug: The Lost Increment

The component has two ways to add 1 to the count: a synchronous **+** button, and a **Delayed +** button that adds 1 after 200ms.

The bug: the delayed callback captures `count` at the moment it was scheduled. By the time it runs, the real count has moved on — but the callback still computes `oldCount + 1` and overwrites everything.

### Symptoms
- Start at 0
- Click **Delayed +** (queues "set to 0 + 1 = 1" for 200ms later)
- Click **+** immediately (count becomes 1)
- 200ms later: count goes back to 1 instead of becoming 2

### Your Task
Make every `+` truly add 1, no matter what else happened while the timer was pending.

> **Think about it:** `setCount(count + 1)` reads `count` from the closure. `setCount(prev => prev + 1)` reads from the **latest** state at update time.
